hero.headline: Private Chef Dining That Feels Like the Best Table in the City
hero.tagline: Reno · Tahoe · Bay Area · Luxury in-home experiences
hero.lede: For hosts who want more than dinner, Siler Chef designs globally inspired menus, refined plating, and an effortless service flow that turns home entertaining into a true occasion.

quote.text: Every menu is a conversation - between season, setting, and the people at your table.

cuisinesSection.lede: A portrait of world traditions - tap a cuisine for courses, tasting notes, and photography.
cuisinesSection.noticeBody: Each cuisine opens into three sample menu sets. Every course can be adjusted to your preferences, dietary needs, or redesigned from scratch.

servicesSection.lede: Corporate milestones, workshops, family tables, and intimate celebrations - open any card for experience pillars and a full image strip.
servicesSection.noticeBody: What you see is a starting point - timing, courses, and flow adapt to your event.

craft.title: From long fermentation to small-batch churning
craft.body1: Every culinary experience is elevated by artisanal preparation. We use professional-grade stone-milling and kneading for signature breads, alongside small-batch churning for fresh sorbets and gelatos, so each course lands at its best texture and flavor.
craft.body2: At Siler Chef, true luxury lives in the details. Every element is hand-crafted from scratch, from long-fermented breads to freshly spun frozen desserts, honoring traditional technique while delivering a polished private-dining experience at home.

cta.headline: Hold your night on the calendar
cta.summary: Choose a time, tell us about your occasion, and we’ll follow up with menu direction.

booking.successText: We’ll follow up shortly to confirm timing and menu direction.

american-cuisine.intro: Three illustrative American menu directions for Siler Chef. Menus can be refined to the client’s preferences or redesigned from scratch for the occasion.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Jumbo Lump Crab Cake - Pan-seared with a citrus-remoulade, pickled micro-fennel, and Old Bay coral tuile.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Maple-Glazed Parker House Rolls - Hand-kneaded, buttery milk rolls served with whipped sea-salt honey butter.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Spiced Cranberry & Blood Orange Sorbet - A vibrant, tart palate cleanser to prepare for the richness of the steak.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Center-Cut Filet Mignon au Poivre - Dry-aged beef, cognac-peppercorn reduction, garlic-confit marble potatoes, and charred broccolini.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Bourbon Vanilla Bean Ice Cream - Freshly churned, served over a warm smoked-apple Tatin with a salted caramel drizzle.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Butter-Poached Maine Lobster - Sweet corn veloute, tarragon oil, and crispy leeks.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Buttermilk & Chive Infused Biscuits - Hand-laminated artisanal biscuits served with whipped maple-bourbon butter.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Honeyed Green Apple Sorbet - A crisp, garden-fresh palate cleanser with a touch of sweetness.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Pan-Seared Muscovy Duck Breast - Roasted parsnip puree, blackberry-balsamic reduction, and honey-glazed baby turnips.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Warm Bourbon-Apple Galette - A rustic, hand-folded tart served with house-spun smoked vanilla bean gelato and a salted caramel drizzle.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Pan-Seared Alaskan Halibut Cheeks - Served over a pea-mint puree, with crispy prosciutto shards and a lemon-caper emulsion.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Rosemary & Sea Salt Pretzel Buns - Artisanal, slow-kneaded soft pretzel rolls served with a sharp Vermont cheddar and craft ale dip.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Wild Raspberry & Tarragon Sorbet - Small-batch botanical sorbet to refresh the senses before the main course.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: 48-Hour Braised Prime Short Ribs - Red wine reduction, silky parsnip mousseline, and honey-roasted heirloom carrots.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Warm Georgia Peach & Pecan Cobbler - A buttery, hand-folded crust served with house-spun bourbon vanilla bean gelato and a dash of cinnamon dust.

italian-cuisine.intro: Three elevated Italian menu directions shaped around artisanal technique, regional warmth, and elegant pacing for private dining.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Wild Mushroom Arancini - Crispy risotto spheres infused with black truffle, served over a silky parmesan fonduta.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Rosemary & Smoked Sea Salt Focaccia - 48-hour fermented high-hydration dough, served with aged balsamic and cold-pressed olive oil.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Sicilian Lemon & Prosecco Sorbet - A sharp, bubbly, and refreshing citrus zest to lift the palate.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Braised Osso Buco over Saffron Risotto - Slow-cooked veal shank, Milanese-style risotto, and an aromatic gremolata.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Toasted Hazelnut Gelato - Freshly churned Italian hazelnut gelato, served with a dark chocolate ganache and almond biscotti crumble.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Pan-Seared Diver Scallops - Cauliflower silk, crispy pancetta, and gremolata oil.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Artisanal Ciabatta with Roasted Garlic - High-hydration, hearth-baked bread served with Sicilian olive oil and sun-dried tomato tapenade.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Blood Orange & Campari Sorbet - A sophisticated, bitter-sweet citrus zest to awaken the senses.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Truffle-Infused Wild Mushroom Pappardelle - Hand-cut pasta tossed in a light porcini cream with shaved 24-month Parmigiano-Reggiano.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Dark Chocolate Flourless Torte - A dense, rich chocolate cake accompanied by silky mascarpone & espresso gelato and a hand-pulled espresso tuile.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Vitello Tonnato Moderne - Shaved veal tenderloin, creamy caper-tuna emulsion, micro-arugula, and salt-cured egg yolk.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Stone-Baked Focaccia Barese - High-hydration, hand-stretched dough topped with cherry tomatoes, olives, and cold-pressed Puglia olive oil.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Aperol & Ruby Grapefruit Sorbet - A sophisticated, slightly bitter-sweet citrus zest to prepare for the main event.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Herb-Roasted Veal Medallions - Porcini mushroom ragu, truffle-infused polenta, and garlic-sauteed kale.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Pistachio Semifreddo - A frozen Italian mousse served with freshly churned Amarena cherry gelato and a toasted almond brittle.

greek-cuisine.intro: Three Greek coastal menu directions built around clarity, herbs, citrus, and polished Aegean hospitality.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Charred Aegean Octopus - Smoked over grapevine, served with fava puree, caper berries, and a lemon-oregano vinaigrette.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Sourdough Pita & Whipped Feta - Hand-stretched, stone-fired sourdough pita served with a spicy Tirokafteri dip and Kalamata olives.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Watermelon & Ouzo Sorbet - A unique, refreshing sorbet with a subtle anise finish, echoing the spirit of the islands.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Herb-Crusted Rack of Lamb - Pistachio and mint crust, served with lemon-garlic roasted potatoes and a honey-red wine reduction.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Greek Yogurt & Wild Honey Ice Cream - Tangy, creamy frozen yogurt churned in-house, topped with caramelized walnuts and thyme-infused honey.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Shrimp Saganaki Elevated - Tiger prawns in a rich tomato-ouzo broth, finished with barrel-aged feta pearls.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Sesame-Crusted Koulouri Rolls - Soft, braided Greek bread served with a whipped Kalamata olive butter.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Lemon & Fresh Garden Mint Sorbet - An ultra-refreshing, botanical palate cleanser.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Salt-Crusted Mediterranean Sea Bass - Whole-baked and deboned, served with an extra virgin olive oil-lemon emulsion and wild-foraged greens.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Honey-Orange Portokalopita - Traditional syrupy orange cake served with small-batch Greek yogurt & wild honey ice cream and toasted pistachio crumble.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Grilled Calamari Ink-Stained - Charred over open flame, served with a squid-ink risotto base and a citrus-ouzo glaze.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Semolina-Crusted Sourdough Loaf - Long-fermentation artisanal bread with a golden crust, served with whipped salted butter and sea fennel.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Pomegranate & Fresh Mint Sorbet - House-spun vibrant crimson sorbet with a cool, refreshing herbal finish.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Pan-Roasted Mediterranean Sea Bream - Served with horta, lemon-oil emulsion, and roasted artichoke hearts.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Deconstructed Baklava Cheesecake - Silky cream cheese mousse, honey-walnut crumble, and house-made cinnamon & thyme honey gelato.

turkish-cuisine.intro: Three luxury Turkish menu directions that reinterpret Anatolian and Ottoman references with modern fine-dining structure.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Smoked Eggplant Hunkar Bites - Silky eggplant puree with aged kashar cheese, topped with slow-cooked pulled lamb and pomegranate arils.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Black Cumin Infused Pide Rolls - Traditional tirnak pidesi reimagined as artisanal rolls, served with cultured sheep’s milk butter and honeycomb.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Pomegranate & Rosewater Sorbet - A floral and exotic crimson sorbet inspired by the gardens of Topkapi Palace.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Slow-Roasted Ishak Pasa Short Rib - 12-hour braised beef over a bed of creamy smoked artichoke hearts and a rich pan jus.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Mastic & Pistachio Ice Cream - Elastic and aromatic mastic ice cream served with warm kabak tatlisi and a tahini-walnut brittle.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Micro-Manti with Smoked Yogurt - Hand-rolled tiny dumplings served with burnt Aleppo-pepper butter and garlic-infused yogurt.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Truffle-Scented Artisanal Simit - Molasses-dipped sesame rings served with cultured sheep’s milk butter.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Black Mulberry Sorbet - An intense berry sorbet with a sharp, sophisticated acidity.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Slow-Roasted Kuyu Kebabi Lamb Shank - 14-hour braised lamb served over a bed of buttery ic pilav with pine nuts and currants.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Warm Caramelized Pumpkin Confit - Served with a tahini-walnut brittle and artisanal roasted walnut & mastic gelato for a perfect balance of temperatures.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Aegean Seabass Ceviche - Cured in lime and raki, served with pomegranate pearls, fresh dill, and extra virgin olive oil.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Stone-Fired Lavash Air Bread - Hand-rolled and puffed to perfection, served with a trio of artisanal mezze: truffle hummus, muhammara, and smoked yogurt.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Quince & Clove Sorbet - A unique, aromatic, and sophisticated palate cleanser inspired by Ottoman palace gardens.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Alinazik Reimagined - Filet mignon tips served over a bed of wood-fire smoked eggplant mousse and burnt brown-pepper butter.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Crispy Kadayif Nest - Golden hand-shredded phyllo served with warm roasted apricots and small-batch mastic-infused clotted cream gelato.

middle-eastern-cuisine.intro: Three international fusion menu directions that blend borderless flavor references with precise private-chef execution.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Ahi Tuna Sashimi & Avocado Silk - Togarashi-crusted tuna, ginger-soy emulsion, and wasabi-infused cucumber ribbons.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Hokkaido Milk Bread & Miso Butter - Ultra-soft Japanese-style rolls hand-kneaded to perfection, served with an umami-rich miso-infused butter.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Yuzu & Fresh Ginger Sorbet - An electric, citrusy zing with a hint of ginger spice to reset the taste buds.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Miso-Glazed Chilean Sea Bass - Pan-seared and glazed with sweet white miso, served over forbidden black rice and a coconut-lemongrass reduction.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Salted Caramel & Espresso Gelato - A rich, bold fusion of dark-roast espresso and buttery caramel, served with a sea-salt chocolate tuile.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Braised Kurobuta Pork Belly - Miso-maple glaze, ginger-pickled daikon, and toasted furikake.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Sourdough French Baguette - Long-fermented, crispy-crust bread served with seaweed-infused cultured butter.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Pineapple & Pink Peppercorn Sorbet - A tropical burst with a subtle, sophisticated spicy kick.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Butter-Poached Australian Lobster Tail - Saffron-coconut reduction, forbidden black rice, and wok-fired bok choy.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: White Chocolate & Passion Fruit Tart - A delicate pastry shell with tart curd, paired with freshly churned ginger-lime gelato and a coconut-lime tuile.

items.name: Appetizer
items.desc: Duck Confit Dumplings - Hand-folded skins filled with five-spice duck, served in a delicate lemongrass-ginger consomme.

items.name: The Bakery
items.desc: Black Garlic Infused Sourdough Rolls - Slow-kneaded dark artisanal rolls served with a creamy salted miso-butter.

items.name: Intermezzo
items.desc: Lychee & Lemongrass Sorbet - Freshly churned exotic sorbet with a bright, electric zing to reset the palate.

items.name: Main Entree
items.desc: Korean-Style Glazed Lamb Chops - Charred over high heat with a gochujang-honey glaze, served with kimchi-fried forbidden rice and baby bok choy.

items.name: Grand Finale
items.desc: Matcha & White Chocolate Fondant - A molten core of Japanese green tea chocolate, served with house-made toasted black sesame gelato and a ginger-snap crumble.
